svg.aria-label: Lumina Engine — a command-based 3D engine for the web
svg.title: Lumina Engine — a command-based 3D engine for the web
svg.text: A command-based 3D engine for browser games:
node-based visual scripting, live GLSL material
editing and GLTF/OBJ/FBX asset pipelines with
Google Drive and Git built in.
